items.title: USN-9062-1: SNMPTT vulnerability
items.summary:
It was discovered that SNMPTT did not properly sanitize trap data passed to
commands run through the EXEC, PREEXEC, and unknown_trap_exec options. A
remote attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary shell
commands.

items.title: USN-9060-1: kramdown vulnerability
items.summary:
It was discovered that kramdown processed the template option in documents
by default. An attacker could possibly use this issue to read arbitrary
files or execute arbitrary code.

items.title: USN-9059-1: ruby-jwt vulnerability
items.summary:
It was discovered that ruby-jwt incorrectly verified HMAC signatures when
the verification key was empty or missing. A remote attacker could possibly
use this issue to forge tokens and bypass authentication.

items.title: USN-9058-1: Action Pack Page Caching vulnerability
items.summary:
It was discovered that Action Pack Page Caching incorrectly handled certain
request paths when writing cached pages. A remote attacker could possibly
use this issue to write arbitrary files to the web server, and possibly
execute arbitrary code.

items.title: USN-9057-1: rkhunter vulnerability
items.summary:
It was discovered that rkhunter downloaded mirror updates over an insecure
channel. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to execute
arbitrary code.

items.title: USN-9055-1: pecl_http vulnerability
items.summary:
It was discovered that pecl_http incorrectly handled certain HTTP request
parameters, leading to a type confusion. A remote attacker could possibly
use this issue to cause PHP to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or
execute arbitrary code.

items.title: USN-9054-1: Babel vulnerability
items.summary:
It was discovered that Babel incorrectly evaluated certain code during
compilation when used with certain plugins. If a user or an automated
system were tricked into compiling specially crafted code, an attacker
could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code.

items.title: USN-9053-1: NetworkManager-ssh vulnerability
items.summary:
It was discovered that NetworkManager-ssh did not properly validate extra
options in VPN connection settings. A local attacker could possibly use
this issue to escalate privileges.
